headline: China Accuses EU of Imposing "Obstacles" on Its Companies After Huawei Ruling
summary: A New York jury found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets and lying to regulators about its activities in Iran. China accused the US of imposing obstacles on Chinese firms in response.
why: Huawei is a major Chinese telecom equipment and smartphone maker, and US sanctions and legal action against it affect global technology supply chains and US-China relations.
original_headline: China acusa a EU de imponer "obstáculos" a sus empresas tras fallo contra Huawei
